mechanism.forced_participant: Short-gamma options dealers whose hedges are coerced by the expiry itself: until the 08:00 UTC last-Friday settlement their delta/gamma hedging obligations bind (pinning and one-sided hedge flow into the print), and at settlement those obligations are extinguished by contract expiry - the deadline is the public venue expiry schedule, not any endogenous market state.
mechanism.late_participant: Unhurried post-expiry liquidity that returns through the remainder of the Friday session after the forced population has transacted and vanished.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: The expiry hour concentrates forced, urgency-priced hedge flow: dealers transact one-sidedly into the settlement because they must, not because the flow carries directional information. Once the instant passes, the coercion stops while the price level it pushed lacks any willing holder - the over-extension resolves (reverts) over the following hours as unhurried liquidity returns. The observable is the settlement-hour taker imbalance; the reaction is its POST-settlement unwind, entered only after the expiry bar is fully closed.
when_it_must_fail: If the settlement-hour imbalance is informative continuation rather than forced over-extension, the post-expiry fade loses: anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0.
If the effect is generic Friday H1 imbalance reversal with no expiry content, the shifted-Friday sham reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x).
If the book is a bare monthly-Friday clock artifact, the clock-only shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it.
If the returns are secretly driven by holiday-thin-Friday liquidity levels (the 2025-11-28 trap), D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the dvol proxies vetoes it before selection.

observable_pinned.definition: imb(symbol, e) = (buy_quote - sell_quote) / quote_total computed on the expiry bar A(e) of the frozen S4 panel - the settlement-hour [08:00,09:00) UTC taker side, fully closed and PIT at decision time (09:00 UTC)
observable_pinned.instant_source: deterministic derivatives calendar: last Friday of each NON-quarterly month at 08:00 UTC, rule verified against Deribit monthly-options expiration_timestamp metadata (see spec_verification)

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels, bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.expiry_bar: A(e) = the bar whose hour_utc equals 08 on the expiry date (the settlement instant 08:00 UTC is the OPEN boundary of A; e.g. 2025-10-31T08:00:00Z -> bar '2025-10-31T08')
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A(e) = 09:00 UTC, the first bar close at which the settlement hour is fully point-in-time - entry is deliberately AFTER the settlement instant so the trade tests post-settlement resolution only
clock.exit_boundary: at the CLOSE of bar A+H (anchor H=12 -> 21:00 UTC same Friday; every fill of every arm lands ON the Friday, never into the weekend)
clock.instant_alignment: pure UTC arithmetic on the frozen H1 index; no DST anywhere in this clock (expiry epochs verified at 08:00:00Z exactly)

ancestry_defense: WKNDLIQ was a Sat/Sun recurring weekday calendar whose book was measured to BE a low-liquidity-level exposure (pooled |rho| 0.5628 vs dvol proxies); P2's clock is 8 sparse FRIDAY instants with full weekday sessions, every fill lands Friday 09:00-21:00 UTC (never into the weekend), and the observable is a bounded side-ratio in which the volume level cancels - the disclosed hazard date (2025-11-28, post-Thanksgiving) is precisely where the F3 dvol_level_log/dvol_shock veto must bite if thin-liquidity level leaks into returns. OICASCADE was an endogenous OI-collapse event book killed by its own randomized-event sham; P2 consumes NO OI anywhere, triggers on nothing endogenous, and carries a shifted-Friday sham of the same falsifying family. ATTN-PHASE was a daily recurring US-session phase on SOL; P2 has no session conditioning, treats all three symbols symmetrically, and its reaction window is anchored on a sparse exogenous expiry clock. FUNDJUMP still carried the funding LEVEL (rho 0.2439); P2 consumes no funding. The generic-imbalance-reversal interpretation (the XSECT-REVERSAL / Bollinger-RSI neighbourhood) is exactly what the shifted-Friday sham and the clock-only shadow are built to falsify: if reversal is generic, a non-expiry Friday reproduces it.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P2's information source is the POST-settlement expiry-hour taker imbalance (the 08:00-09:00 UTC forced-hedge flow) on the NON-QUARTERLY monthly options-expiry clock, with an unwind-FADE reaction entered at 09:00 UTC and held through Friday. P1 (CNG1-A5-P1) uses PRE-instant accumulated pressure (00:00..06:00 UTC) on the QUARTERLY delivery clock with a drift-CONTINUATION reaction that is flat at the delivery instant. Different information-source layer, opposite reaction form, and disjoint event dates (quarterly vs non-quarterly last Fridays; FOMC instants of lane A4 also disjoint from both grids - checked). Cross-proposal collapse is tested by frozen rule F5.

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 fires, fading the settlement-hour imbalance works just as well on ordinary non-expiry Fridays - the monthly expiry clock carries no incremental information and the forced-hedge-unwind mechanism is dead on this substrate; it must not be re-clocked to quarterly dates (P1's separate test) or to daily expiries without a NEW preregistered proposal. If F3 fires on the dvol proxies, the family was secretly a holiday/thin-Friday liquidity exposure - exactly the WKNDLIQ death this lane pre-disclosed, and an honest kill. If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow also lose), it is a plain negative: post-expiry unwind is either absent at H1 granularity on these three books or smaller than measured tier-2.0 costs - one more instance of settlement-hour imbalance being informative continuation rather than forced over-extension. Any of these outcomes feeds CRYPTO_NG1_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
